text.body: tantryate dhāryate śarīramaneneti tantram tasya guṇāstantraguṇāḥ yaistantramalaṃkriyate tantrayuktyādayaḥ tairevaṃ prakārairyuktam| tathā coktaṃ saṅgrahe u a 50- alaṅkṛtaṃ yuktipadaiḥ sadratnairiva kāñcanam|ṣaṭtriṃśatā'rthadurgeṣu bhiṣajāṃ saṅkramairiva| tatrādhikaraṇaṃ yogo hetvartho'rthaḥ padasya ca| pradeśoddeśanirdeśavākyaśeṣāḥ prayojanam|| upadeśāpadeśātideśārthāpattinirṇayāḥ| praṅgaikāntanaikāntāḥ sāpavargo viparyayaḥ|| pūrvapakṣavidhānānumatavyākhyānasaṃśayāḥ| atītānāgatāpekṣāsvasaṃjñohyasamuccayāḥ|| nidarśanaṃ nirvacanaṃ niyogo'tha vikalpanam| pratyutsārastathoddhāraḥ sambhavastantrayuktayaḥ|| iti | tatra adhikaraṇaṃ nāma- yadadhikṛktya pravartate śāstraṃ sthānamadhyāyaḥ prakaraṇaṃ vākyaṃ vā| tatra śāstrādhikaraṇaṃ - yadadhikṛtya śāstraṃ pravartate | yathā- aṣṭāvaṅgānyadhikṛtya hṛdayākhyaṃ sarvaṃ śāstraṃ pravṛttaṃ| yathoktaṃ kāyabāla 1 5 ityādi| sthānādhikaraṇaṃ yathā- atrārthāḥ sūtritāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratanyante hi sarvataḥ|30 53 iti | adhyāyo'pi yadadhikṛtya pravartate tat prakaraṇādhikaraṇam| yathā- athāto dinacaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti prakaraṇaṃ yadadhikṛtya pravartate tat prakaraṇādhikaraṇam| yathā- daśamūlasirā hṛtsthāstāḥ sarvaṃ sarvato vapuḥ| ityādi yāvat ityavedhyavibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ| ityādi| evaṃ vākyamapi yadadhikṛtya pravartate tadvākyādhikaraṇaṃ vedyam || yogo nāma yojanā uddeśanirdeśayoḥ sūtrabhāṣyayorvā| yathā - athato'ṅgavibhāgaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | hṛ śā 3 ityuddiśyāṅgāni vibhajate- śiro'ntarādhirdvau bāhū sakthinī ca samāsataḥ| ṣaḍaṅgam ityādi | yuktirvā yogaḥ pratijñāheturdṛṣṭānta upanayo nigamanamiti pañcavidhaḥ| yathā- agniḥ śarīrasthitermūlamiti pratijñā | agnipakvāhāre sati tatsthiteriti hetuḥ | tatrāgnirheturāhārānnahyapakvādrasādayaḥ| hṛ śā 3 55 iti vacanāt| yathā śālyaṅkurasya bījamiti dṛṣṭāntaḥ| upanayo yathā- cikitsāśāstrasya prayojanatvasādhanāya bahudhā dṛṣṭāntopanayaṃ kṛtavāṃstantrakṛt kasyāsiddho'gnitoyādiḥ u 40 68 ityādayaḥ| tasmāt saprayoganameva cikitsāśāstraṃ pratyakṣaphalatvādityupanayaḥ| tasmādārambhaṇīyamiti pramāṇapadopadarśanamukhena nigamanam | yathoktaṃ catuṣpād daguṇasampanne samyagālocya yojite | mā kṛthā vyādhinirghātaṃ vicikitsāṃ cikitsite || sādhyavyādhicikitsāyāṃ saṃśayānupapattyā pratipāditayā pramāṇaphalopasaṃharakaraṇam | hetvartho nāma - yadanyaprastāvoktamanyatrāpi tathaivopapadyate | yathā- tatekaikaṃ ca śākhāyāṃ śataṃ tasminna vedhayet| sirāṃ jālandharāṃ nāma tisraścābhyantarāśritāḥ || ityādi hṛ śā 3 20| tathā - avedhyāḥ saṅkīrṇā grathitā kṣudrāḥ ityādi | tadetebhyo viśeṣavacanebhyo'numīyate śeṣā vedhyā iti | anyathaitāni vacāṃsi nirarthakāni syuriti | padārtho nāma - padenartho gamyate| yathā dravyamiti padaṃ tasyārtho bhūjalādiḥ| guṇa iti padaṃ tasyārtho gurvādiḥ| pradeśo nāma - yeṣāmarthānāmatibahutvāt sākalyenābhidhānasyāśakyatvāt stokamucyate| yathoktaṃ - iti dravaikadeśo'yaṃ yathāsthūlamudāhṛtaḥ|hṛ sū 5 84 iti | uddeśo nāma - saṃṅkṣepābhidhānam| yathā - vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaśceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ| ityādi | nirdeśo nāma - tasyaiva vistāroktiḥ| yathoktaṃ - tatra rūkṣo laghu śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaścalo'nilaḥ| iti vākyaśeṣo nāma- yasmin sūtre lāghavikenārthādgamyamānamanuktapūraṇārthamadhyāhriyate| yathā- tatra khāt khāni dehe'smin bhavanti iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| āpyā jihvārasakledāḥ śā 3 4 ityuttaratra bhāvārtho taddhitaśravaṇāt| prayojanaṃ nāma- yadarthaṃ śāstrādi pravartate| yathā - ātaṅkapaṅkamagnānāṃ hastālambo bhiṣagjitam | u 40 64 | anena prayojanena cikitsāśāstramadhyeyamityādi | upadeśo nāma - āptavacanam| yathā - snehaklinnāḥ koṣṭhagā dhātugā vā strotolīnā ye ca śākhāsthisaṃsthāḥ| doṣāḥ svedaiste dravīkṛtya koṣṭhaṃ nītāḥ samyakśuddhirnirhriyante| itādi| apadeśo nāma -yadācāryaḥ kiñcidarthaṃ pratijñāya hetumupadiśati| yathā- jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāmevanaudhāt | iti pratijñāya hetumāha u 40 65 - na hyupāyamapekṣante sarve rogāḥ sarvarogāṇāmupāyāpekṣābhāvāt | atideśo nāma - yat kiñcidevārthajātamuktārtha sādhanāya evamanyadapi pratyetavyamiti paribhāṣāyāṃ sthāpayati | yathoktaṃ karṇarogapratiṣedhe u 18 4- mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṣṭhāt kṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt | tailasiktātpradīptāgrāt snehaḥ sadyo rujāpahaḥ|| yojyaścaivaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhātkuṣṭhāt kāṣṭhācca sāralāt | ityādi | arthāpattirnāma- yo'nyenārthenoktena tato'paro'pyartho gadita iva jñāyate | yathā- naivādyānniśi naivoṣṇam | ityuktaṃ na tūktaṃ divā bhuñjīteti | etaccārthāpattyā gamyate| nanu kaḥ punararthaḥ kā cāsyāpattiḥ brūmaḥ| dadhyabhyavahāro'rthastatra tantrakṛtā naivādyānniśi iti kālo niṣiddho na tu dadhibhakṣaṇam| tato yo'yamapratiṣiddho'rthaḥ sa āpadyate divā dadhibhojanārthaḥ rātripratiṣedhe dinavyatirekeṇa kālāntarābhāvāt| sarvathā anabhyavaharaṇīyasyāhāraprastāve pratiṣedhānupapatteḥ| evamanyātrāpi vyākhyeyam| nirṇayo nāma - yannivāritasyārthasya pratiṣṭhāpanam| yathā - dṛśyante bhagavan kecidātmavanto'pi rogiṇaḥ| ityādinā cikitsāśāstraphalaṃ prati saṃśayakaraṇe paścānnirṇayārthamuktam| yathā- na cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitumarhati| ityādi prasaṅgo nāma - pūrvābhihitasyārthasya kenacit sambandhāntareṇa punarabhidhānam | yathoktaṃ sirāvyadhavidhau 27 2 lohitaṃ pravadecchuddhatanostenaiva ca sthitiḥ | ityuktvā punaḥ śarīre śuddhārtavaprasaṅgenoktaṃ- śuddhe śukrārtave satvaḥ svakarmakleśacoditaḥ | garbhaḥ sampadyate yuktivaśādagnirivāraṇau || iti | na ca punaruktatā tasya| yasmāt sirāvyadhe śarīraprabhavatvameva raktasyoktaṃ na tu kramo varṇitaḥ| śārīre tu yayā''nupūrvyā śarīrahetuḥ syāt tadvistareṇoktam | yathā- bījātmakairmahābhūtaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ satvānugaiśca saḥ| mātuścāhārarasajaiḥ kramāt kukṣau vivardhate || iti| ekānto nāma - ya ekameva pakṣamavyabhicāreṇa śrayati nānyam | tadyathā - ye bhūtaviṣavāyvagnikṣata bhaṅgādisambhavāḥ rāgadveṣabhayādyāśca te syurāgantavo gadāḥ || iti| naikānto nāma – anyatarapakṣānavadhāraṇāt | yathā- jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣāmeva nauṣadhāt | ekāntena - na hyupāyamapekṣante sarve rogāḥ ityādi || apavargo nāma - sākalyenotsṛṣṭasya yatpunastadekadeśāpakarṣaṇam| yathā- śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyairupakrāntāśca ye gadāḥ| samyak sādhyā n siddhyanti te ca raktaprakopajāḥ| teṣu srāvayituṃ raktamudriktaṃ vyadhayetsirām | ityutsargamabhidhāya ekadeśe'pavādaṃ vakti - na tūnaṣoḍaśātītasaptatyabdasrutāsṛjām | ityādi| viparyayo nāma- yathopadiṣṭaviparyayeṇa lakṣaṇādikaraṇam | yathoktaṃ- vātānulomyaṃ dīpto'rgnirvacaḥ snigdhamasaṃhatam | snehodvegaḥ klamaḥ samyak snigdhe rūkṣe viparyayaḥ|| iti| pūrvapakṣo nāma- pratijñātārthasyasaṃdūṣaṇaṃ vākyam| yathā hitāhitavibhāgaṃ pratyācikhyāsannāha | yathā - dṛśyante bhagavān kecit ityārabhya yāvāt hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmādaniścitam | ityādi | vidhānaṃ nāma- yatprakaraṇānupūrvaṃ vidhānamāvekṣyate | anumataṃ nāma- uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ dvidhaivānye vīryamācakṣate'pi ca | nānātmakamapi dravyamagnīṣomau mahābalau || ityādinā hyanumataṃ na vighātaḥ kṛtaḥ| vyākhyānaṃ nāma - yanmādṛśebhyo viśiṣṭatarabuddhigamyam|yathā- saptāhāt kalalībhavet | dvitīye māsi kalalāt ghanaḥ peśyathavārbudam | puṃstrīklībāḥ kramāt iti | na hyatra garbhasyāvartamānā bhāvāḥ śakyā vijñātuṃ yogidṛṣṭiṃ muktvā | saṃśayo nāma - sākāṅkṣatvamaniścitavastu vijñānam|yathā - saṃśayaṃ prāptamātreyo jīvitaṃ tasya manyate| ityādi | atītāpekṣaṇaṃ nāma- yadatikrāntamapekṣya prastutasya sādhanamucyate | yathoktaṃ hṛdrogacikitsite - rāsnājīvaka ityādi yāvat mahāsnehaṃ vipācayet || iti| atra ca na jāyate katamo mahāsneha iti | tadetadatikrāntamapekṣya prasādhyate snehavidhyuktam | yathā - dvābhyāṃ tribhiścaturbhistairyamakastrivṛto mahān | ityāpekṣya vyākhyāyate | anāgatāpekṣā nāma-- svasaṃjñā nāma -yā tantrakāraiḥ svatantrasaṃvyāvāhārārthaṃ praṇītā satī paratantreṣu na vyavaharati | yathā śākhā raktādayastvak ca iti | ūhyaṃ nāma -yadapratibaddhaṃ granthe svayaṃ prajñayā tarkayitvā yojyam| yathoktaṃ -trayastriṃśaditi proktā vargāsteṣu tvalābhataḥ| yuñjyāt tadvidhamanyacca dravyaṃ jahyādayaugikam || iti samuccayo nāma yathā peyāṃ vilepīmakṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ ca samuccinoti tathā - trīnubhaya tathaikam | krameṇa seveta naro'nnakālān pradhānamadhyāvaraśuddhiśuddhaḥ|| iti| nidarśanaṃ nāma- yannidarśayitavyaṃ sūkṣmamapyarthaṃ svadharmasādṛśayāt | spaṣṭīkarotyādarśa iva mukhavidhum | yathoktaṃ- yathā kusumbhādiyutāttoyādrāgaṃ haretpaṭaḥ| tathā dravīkṛtāt dehād bastirnirharate malān || ityādi | nirvacanaṃ nāma - nirṇayārthaṃ vacanaṃ niruktam| yathoktaṃ viṣavidhāne mathyamāne jalanidhāvamṛtārthaṃ surāsuraiḥ|| iti | yāvat viṣasya nirvacanaṃ jagadviṣamiti | niyogo nāma- yo yasyānuṣṭheyaḥ| yathā - uṣṇodakopacārī syāt ityādi | vikalpo nāma - vividhaṃ kalpanam idaṃ kāryamidaṃ vā kāryam| yathoktaṃ pūrvarūpadarśane jvarādau vā hitaṃ laghvaśanamapatarpaṇam vā | pratyutsāro nāma - yatropapattiṃ darśayantaḥ parasparamatāni nivārayanti | tadyathā - asthnāṃ śatāni ṣaṣṭhiśca trīṇi dantanakhaiḥ saha| dhanvantaristu trīṇyāha sandhīnāṃ ca śatadvayam||daśottaraṃ sahasre dve nijagādātrinandanaḥ| iti pūrvamatāt ṣaṣṭhiṃ pratyutsārayati| dhanvantarerapi mataṃ daśottaraṃ sandhiśatadvayamiti punarvasuḥ pratyutsārayati ṛ codyasya samādhanam| tadyathā- dṛśyante bhagavān kecidātmavanto'pi rogiṇaḥ| yāvat hitāhitāvibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmādaniścitam| iti kṛte codye- na cikitsā'cikitsā ca tulyā bhaviturmahati iti pariharaḥ|| udvāro nāma śāstrārambhapratyākhyānādi codyasya samādhānam| tadyathā -dṛśyante bhagavan kecidātmavanto'pi rogiṇaḥ| yāvat hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmādaniścitam | iti kṛte codye- na cikitsā'cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitumarhati iti parihāraḥ | sambhavo nāma- upapattiryasminnupapadyate anupadiṣṭe| yathā - duṣṭaraktāpagamanāt sadyo rāgarujāṃ śamaḥ|ityuktam|pracchānālabujalaukāśṛṅgasirāvyadhairyathasambhavaṃ raktamapanīyate| yathoktaṃ- pracchānenaikadeśasthaṃ grathitaṃ jalajanmabhiḥ| harecchṛṅgādibhiḥ suptamasṛgvyāpi sirāvyadhaiḥ| iti evamanyatrāpi sambhavārtho yojyaḥ| vyākhyā api tantrasya guṇaḥ| tābhirapi tantramalaṅkriyate| tāśca pañcadaśa prakārāḥ| tadyathā- piṇḍapadapadārthādhikaraṇaprakaraṇārthakṛcchraphaloccitakanyāsaprayojanānulomapratilomātisūtrasamastavyākhyāḥ| tatra piṇḍavyākhyā nāma - saṅkṣepatayā sūtrarūpeṇādhyāyādīnāṃ vyākhyā| yathā- rūpendriyasvaracchāyāpraticchāyākriyādiṣu| anyeṣvapi ca bhāveṣu prākṛteṣvanimittataḥ|| vikṛtiryā samāsena riṣṭaṃ taditi lakṣayet| ityanena sakariṣṭādhyāya samāsa uktaḥ| padavyākhyā nāma - yatpadānāṃ chedaṃ kṛtvoccāraṇam| yathā - atha ataḥ āyuṣkāmīyaṃ adhyayaṃ vi ākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti saptapadaṃ sūtraṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam| padārthavyākhyā nāma teṣāmeva padānāṃ vivaraṇam| yathā atha śabdaṃ ānantarye adhikāre vā ataḥ śabdo hetāvityādi| adhikaraṇavyākhyā nāma yadvastukṛtamārabhya tadanuṣaṅgeṇa vyākhyānamārabhyate| yathā- athāto dinacaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti pratyutya brāhme muhūrta uttiṣṭhetsvastho rakṣārthamāyuṣaḥ| ityādinā saiva dinacaryā vivṛtya vyākhyāyate savistarā| prakaraṇavyākhyā nāma yasminnarthe sūtre vā prakṛtenāprakṛtaṃ sādhyate yathā - trilavaṇādye cūrṇe guṇānuktvā'bhayākhye evamāha samānaṃ pūrveṇa iti| tatra samānaguṇatā vyākhyātā| arthavyākhyāna nāma yatra prakaraṇe sūtre vā svabhāvasyopavarṇanaṃ kriyate| tadyathā - prakṛtirucyate svabhāvaḥ| sa punarāhārauṣadhadravyāṇāṃ svabhāviko gurvādiguṇayogaḥ| tadyathā- māṣamudgayoḥ sūkaraiṇayośca| kṛcchravyākhyā nāma - yatra leśata uktānāmavispaṣṭānāṃ prakaraṇe sūtre vā arthānāṃ yatnata udbhāvanaṃ kriyate| tadyathā- anuyāyātpratipadaṃ sarvadharmeṣu madhyamām| iti leśato bruvāṇaḥ śāstrakāraḥ sarveṣu hetuliṅgauṣadhādiṣu madhyamā pratipadāśrayaṇīyeti sūcayati| phalavyākhya nāma - yatra vastuni bahuṣvaniścitārtheṣvekīyamateṣu prastuteṣu vastusārabhūtaṃ svamataṃ svamarthamupanikṣipyaikīyamatāni tasminneva svamate'ntarbhāvaṃ nayati| yathā dvādaśa prasṛto nirūhaḥ kāryaḥ ityeke| mātrāṃ tripalikāṃ kuryāt snehamākṣikayoḥ pṛthak| ityādyanye| tadetāni matāni doṣauṣadhabalāpekṣayā svamatāntarbhāvitāni pramāṇāni ca| yathoktaṃ- doṣauṣadhādibalataḥ sarvametatpramāṇayet| anyonyaviruddhamapi samyaṅnirūḍhaliṅgaṃ tu nāsambhāvya nivartayet|| iti| uccitakavyākhyā nāma- yasmin sūtre nidarśanabhūtānyudāharaṇāni tantrāntaḥ samākṛṣyārthaḥ śasyate| yathā- pṛthivyādiṣu ca mahābhūtasaṃjñā sthāpitā rasādiṣu ca dhātusaṃjñā niveśitā| rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjaśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ| iti| punarucyate- parasparopasaṃstambhāddhātusnehaparamparā| iti| atra kiṃ dhātorgrahaṇena bhūtānyapi dhātuśabdavācyāni bhavanti iti| nyāsavyākhyā nāma - yasminnadhikāre vartamāne tenādhikaraṇārthena sahitaṃ sambandhamabhivīkṣyānyasyārtho vinikṣipyate| yathā -dṛśyante bhagavan kecidātmavanto'pi rogiṇaḥ| iti hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ prati saṃśayamabhivikṣya na cikitsā'cikitsā ca tulyā bhaviturmahati| ityādinā uttaraṃ datvā tenaiva prasaṅgenānyo'rtho nikṣipyate| yathā - etattadamṛtaṃ sākṣājjagadāyāsavarjitam| yāti halāhalatvaṃ tu sadyo durbhājanasthitam|| iti| evamanyeṣāmapyarthānāṃ sambandhamavadhāryaṃ vyākhyā'rthārhā kalpanīyā| prayojanavyākhyā nāma- yatsūtramabhidhīyamānaṃ svārthasya niṣpattau nimittabhāvamupaiti| yathā - ukto'ṅgavibhāge'nekadhā sirāvistaraḥ| na ca tena sirāvistaraṇoktena kiñcidihopakāro dṛśyate| yadi prakaraṇāvasare prayojanamidaṃ brūyāt ityavedhyavibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ| etadarthaṃ sirāvaraṇaṃ pravṛttam| anulomyaṃ nāma tatra pradhānakalpanā dvidhā- pradhānasya kalpanā pradhānena vā kalpanā pradhānakalpanā| pradhānasya kalpanā yathā- sarpiḥ snehanaṃ kṣīraṃ jīvanaṃ madhu sandhānakṛt ityatra madhye prakṛṣṭaguṇatvāt sarpiḥ kṣīre snehajīvane kalpyete na tu tailayogādiṣvapi snehajīvanatvaṃ nāstīti| mākṣikaṃ ca sandhāne pradhānatvāt sandhānakṛdityuktaṃ na tu sikthakamadhuyaṣṭikādiṣvapi sandhānakṛtvaṃ nāstīti| pradhānena tu kalpanā yathā- kṣīradadhitakramastunavanītakṣīraghṛtapurāṇaghṛtakilāṭapīyūṣakūcīkāmoraṇādivargaḥ sarvaḥ kṣīravarga ityuktaḥ kṣīraprādhānyāt| pradhānena kalpanāvyapadeśa ityeko'rthaḥ| guṇakalpanā nāma - yena nirdiṣṭaṃ pratyekaṃ taccaturguṇam|| ityādi| dakṣatvādicaturguṇanirdeśaḥ sarvathā praśaṃsāguṇa iti gamyate| leśakalpanā nāma - anupadiṣṭasya vidheḥ kaṇṭhapāṭhena yatkiñcitsūtrāvayavāntaramāśrityārthaḥ kalpyate| yathā- nātra śāstre kālamṛtyorakālamṛtyorvā kiñcillakṣaṇaṃ praṇītam| tattu leśato'numīyate| kathamiti yadā hi kālaniyatamāyuḥ kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ bhavati tadā riṣṭamutpadyate na viṣamaparihāreṇa mriyamāṇe nare| uktaṃ hi- bhiṣagbheṣajapānānnagurumitradidviṣaśca ye| vaśagāḥ sarva evaite vijñeyāḥ samavartinaḥ| iti| atra vikṛtivijñānīye gurumitradviṣaśceti ca śabdo'smācchlokāt pūrvakāṇi yāni cottarāṇi tāni sarvāṇyeva samuccinoti| samavartī hi kālo mṛtyuriṣṭaḥ itaratvasamartī| ata eva cācaṣṭe tantrāntare- kālamṛtyoreva riṣṭāni nākālamṛtyoḥ| iti svābhiprāyaprakāśanārthaṃ tantrakāraḥ śakaṭodāharaṇaṃ dattavān| yathā- sama eva vāhyamānaḥ svapramāṇakṣaye bhaṅgapūrvarūpāṇyāpnoti| tathā niyatāyuṣaḥ svapramāṇakṣaye riṣṭasambhavaḥ| yathā ca - sa evātibhārakrāntatvādviṣamapathāśritatvādakāle'pi kṣayamāpnoti| tathā aniyatāyuṣo riṣṭotpattimantareṇa mṛtyuḥ| yadi punaraniyatāyuṣo'pi riṣṭotpattipūrvaṃ maraṇaṃ kalpyeta tadā vārṣike ṣāṇmāsike vā'riṣṭe samutpanne śubhahetuyogānna mṛtyuḥ syāt| aniyatāyuṣo hi samyagupacārājjīvitānuvṛttiḥ| viṣamahetvaparihārānmṛtyuḥ| ata evāniyatāyuṣamadhikṛtya rasāyanānyupadiṣṭāni| tadyogādayaṃ bahūnyapi varṣāṇi jīvet| niyatāyuṣastu kālamṛtyuvarṣaśatāt pareṇa jīvitaṃ na nirdiṣṭam| yathoktaṃ śārīre - maraṇaṃ prāṇināṃ dṛṣṭamāyuḥ puṇyobhayakṣayāt| tayorapyakṣayād dṛṣṭaṃ viṣamāparihāriṇām| iti| tasmādaviśeṣoktāvapi niyatāyuṣa evāriṣṭotpattipūrvaṃ maraṇamiti niścitam| tathā ca ṛtucaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti pratijñāyāṃ ṣaḍṛtuviśeṣe pratipattirbhavati| na tu ṝtustu dvādaśaniśāḥ asya ṛtoriti| vidyākalpanā nāma -yathā sarvavidyānugatārthanirdeśe śāstrakārasya sarvavidyāsthānānupraveśa iha śāstre hita iti vacanadvinā'pīṣyate| tatra ārdrasantānatā tyāgaḥ ityādinā vākyena buddhivacanaviṣaya adhyātmavidyāsaṅgraha iṅgyate| arcayeddevagovipra ityādinā dharmaśāstropadeśasaṅgrahaḥ| tathā jagadviṣāṇṇāṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ| ityādinā padavyutpādanānniruktakaraṇācca śabdavidyāyā nirukteścopasaṅgrahaḥ| sādhake'hani sūtikāṃ gṛhaṃ praveśayet| tathā bharaṇīkṛttikāśleṣāpūrvārdrāpitṛnaiṛte| iti jyotiḥ śāstroparodhaḥ| vicitrabhūṣitaśāstrasyotpekṣaṇīyam| bhakṣyakalpanā nāma - etattadamṛtaṃ sākṣāt ityādi ājñākalpanā nāma - yasyānuṣṭhāne hetuḥ samyagavantuṃ na śakyaḥ kevalamāptavacanaṃ pramaṇīkṛtyānuṣṭhīyate| yathā - na chindyāttṛṇam na bhuvaṃ likhet iti| na hyatra heturvaktuṃ śakyate etadanuṣṭheyamiti| iyaṃ saptavidhā kalpanā, viśatyaśrayā bhavati| yathā - ādilopaḥ madhyalopaḥ antalopaḥ ubhayapadalopaḥ ādimadhyāntalopaḥ varṇopajananam ṛṣikliṣṭam tantraśīlam tantrasaṃjñā prakṛtam samānatantrapratyayaḥ paratantrapratyayaḥ hetuhetukadharmaḥ kāryakāraṇadharmaḥ ādyantaviparyayaḥ śabdāntaram pratyayaḥ upanayaḥ sambhavaḥ vibhavaḥ iti| tatra ādilopo nāma -yathā bṛṃhaṇaḥ prīṇano vṛṣyaścakṣaṣyo vraṇaharā rasaḥ| ityatra māṃsaśabdalopena| tathā ca- dhāraṇodīraṇaniśā ityādau dhāraṇaṃ vegadhāraṇam udīraṇaṃ vegodīraṇamiti| madhyalopo nāma -yathā dravadravyavijñānīyamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| ityatra dravadravyasvarūpavijñānīyo dravadravyavijñānīya ityuktaḥ anantaraṃ anna svarūpavijñānīyaḥ ityatra svarūpaśabdaśravaṇāt| antalopo nāma - yathā - kaphaṃ punaḥ gauryaḥ snigdhāḥ śirāḥ śītāḥ vahante ityatrāsraśabdasya lopo draṣṭavyaḥ pūrvatrāsraśabdasya prakṛtatvāt| yathoktaṃ- tatra śyāvāruṇāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pūrṇariktāḥ kṣaṇāt sirāḥ|praspandinyaśca vātāsram iti| evamihāpi kaphāsra vahanta ityanumeyam tulyajātīyatvāt| ubhayapadalopo nāma - yathā- adau ṣaḍrasamapyannaṃ madhurībhūtamīrayet| iti vacane madhye vidāhādamlatāṃ tataḥ|| pittamāmāśayātkuryāccyavamānaṃ cyutaṃ punaḥ| ante agninā śoṣitaṃ pakvaṃ piḍitaṃ kaṭu mārutam|| iti| ādiśabdaśravaṇāt madhyāntaśabdāvatra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyau| ādimadhyāntalopo nāma - yathā annāṃ kāle'bhyavṛtaṃ ādau koṣṭhaṃ prāṇānilāhṛtam| madhye ante ca dravyaiḥ ityādi| varṇopajananaṃ nāma - yatrānukto granthe varṇa ācāryeṇa paścād vyākhyānakāla upajanyārtho'bhidhīyate| yathā -tatra khātkhāni dehe'smin śrotraṃ śabdo viviktatā| tathā- vātātsparśatvagucchvāsā vahnerdṛgrūpaktayaḥ| bhavanti iti varṇatrayamupajanya vyākhyā karaṇīyā| āpyā jihvārasakledā ghrāṇagandhāsthi pārthivam| iti dvayorbhūtayorbhāvārthe taddhitapratyayaśravaṇāt| vākyaśeṣo'pyayamevaṃ prāya eva| ṛṣikliṣṭaṃ nāma - yadṛṣī ṛṣiputro vā'samāhitacittatayā'śaktyā vā kiñcitpadajātamajātaṃbhraṣṭamuccāritavān tathaiva talloke prayujyate| yathā -roma loma ityādi| tantraśīlaṃ nāma- yā tantrakāraṇaṃ prakṛtiḥ svabhāva ityarthaḥ| yathā- kiñcicchiṣyānugrahārthaṃ vistīrṇaṃ saṅkṣipanti yathā -asthnāṃ śatāni ṣaṣṭiśca trīṇi dantanakhaiḥ saha| iti na nānyaṅgulihastapādamaṇibandhādi vibhāgena vistāritāni| kiñcidvistārayanti yathā - tatraivāṅgavibhāgena vistāritāḥ ityavedhyavibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ| iti vacanāditi| tantrasaṃjñā nāma - yatkismiścidarthe madhye vyākhyāyamāne svatantrasiddhodāharaṇaṃ tatpramāṇārthamucyate| yathā- navajvare kaṣāyā apakveṣu doṣeṣu varjanīyā uktāḥ tataḥ pakveṣu doṣeṣu laṅghanādyaiḥ praśasyate| kaṣāyo doṣaśeṣasya pācanaḥ śamano'thavā|| iti viśeṣavacanāttatra svarasādeḥ pañcavidhasya kaṣāyasya pratiṣedhaḥ prasaktaḥ| tataḥ svataṃntrasaṃjñayā viśeṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate- tiktaḥ pitte viśeṣeṇa prayojyaḥ kaṭukaḥ kaphe| ityādi| tasmāt svatantrasaṃjñayā tiktakaṭukaṣāyau niṣiddhau pañcavidhayā svarasādikalpanayā| prakṛtaṃ nāma - ūṣakastutthakaṃ hiṅgu kāsīsadvayasaindhavam| ityauṣadhādhikārāt saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ natvaśvādikam| samānatantrapratyayo nāma- yatsādhyasya kasyacidarthasya sādhanāyānupalabhyamāne svatantrād pratyaye samānebhyastantrebhyaḥ pratyayaḥ iti| udāharaṇaṃ yathā- nīcalomanakhaśmaśruḥ ityācāreṣūktam| iyadbhiriyadbhirdinaiḥ keśanakhaśmaśrūṇyavatārya nīcalomādinā bhavitavyamiti noktam| tato vyākhyākārāḥ kṣārapāṇiprabhṛtayaḥ prasiddhā daśarātreṇa keśādīnāṃ saṃgrahamiti niścinvanti| munistvādīt- tribhiḥ pakṣasya keśaśmaśrulomanakhān saṃhārayet| iti| paratantrapratyayo nāma yasyārthasya prasiddhito na svakīyamudāharaṇaṃ śakyamabhidhātuṃ nāpyanyebhyo bhiṣaktantrebhyaḥ| tatastasmin dvaye praratantrādudāharaṇaṃ kalapyate| yathā - kālārthakarmaṇāṃ yogo hīnamithyātimātrakaḥ| samyaggogaśca vijñeyo rogārogyaikakāraṇam|| ityuktam| yogasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ noktaṃ tantre anyatra vā bhiṣaktantre tatra bauddhatantrapratyayena niścīyate- svahetubhyaḥ śītoṣṇādilakṣaṇena kālasyotpattireva yogaḥ| iti| hetuhetukadharmo nāma - yo hetuhetukena dharmo jñāyate| yathā- pittātisāriṇaḥ pittalātisevanāt pittamudriktaṃ raktātisārāya na cirādasya bhaviṣyatītyanumīyate samarthasya hetoḥ svakāryasyāvyabhicārāt| kāryakāraṇadharmo nāma - yatra kāryasaṃjñayā kāraṇaṃ nirdiśyate kāraṇasaṃjñayā vā kāryaṃ tatra kāryasaṃjñayā tāvatkāraṇaṃ nirdiśyate| yathā doṣā api rogaśabdaṃ labhante| tatra doṣāḥ kāraṇaṃ- sarveṣāmeva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ| iti vacanāt| na cedānīṃ doṣo roga iti vyapadiśyamānaḥ kāraṇe doṣe kāryaṃ roga upacarito bhavati| evaṃ kāryakāraṇasaṃjñayā nirdiśyate| ādyantaviparyayo nāma - yathā- annasvarūpavijñānaṃ prāptamujjhitvā pānameva prathamamuktaṃ dravadravyavijñānaṃ kuvatā toyadīnāṃ pañcānāṃ vargāṇāmalpavaktavyatvat| samudropamatayā śāstrasyānupūrvasukhāvagāhanārthaṃ pūrvaṃ hyalpaṃ sukhenāvagāhyate paścātprabhūtamiti nyāyāt| śabdānyatvaṃ nāma- yadarthaṃ paryāyaśabdaṃ varṇayanti śāstrakṛtaḥ| yathā - rogaḥ pāpmā jvaro vyādhirvikāro duḥkhamāmayaḥ| yakṣmātaṅkagadābādhāḥ śabdāḥ paryāyavācinaḥ|| ityādi| pratyayadharmo nāma- yo na ca heturhetudharmopapattimātreṇa ca kenaciddhetutvena vyapadiśyate| yathā- devadānavagandharvādyunmādāpasmārādivicitragrahavikārā uktāḥ| yathoktaṃ - phullapadmopamamukhaṃ saumyadṛṣṭimakopanam| yāvat anidramapraghṛṣyaṃ ca vidyaddevavaśīkṛtam| ityādi| na caite paramārthato hetavaḥ kiṃ tarhi prajñāparādhaḥ| tathā coktaṃ - hetustadanuṣaktau tu sadyaḥ pūrvakṛto'thavā| prajñāparadhaḥ sutarām iti| upanayo nāma - sūtrahetuprastāvena yatrānyaprakaraṇamupanīyate| yathā mātrāśītīye āhāramātrālakṣaṇaprastāve atimātrabhojananimittāyā visūcikāyāścikitsā upanītā| mātrāyāṃ hi vibhajyamānāyāmavaśyamūnātimātre'pi vibhajanīye tadapekṣayā mātrāyāḥ samyak pratipādanasaukaryāt tatprastāvena ca visūcikāyāścikitsā| sambhavo nāma - yatsūtraṃ prakaraṇaṃ va vidhīyamānarthasya vyāpakatvāt sakalena śāstreṇa vyākhyāyate| yathā kāyabālagrahordhvāṅgaśalyadaṃṣṭrājarāvṛṣān| aṣṭāvaṅgāni tasyāhuścikitsā yeṣu saṃśrītā| iti| etānyāṣṭāvaṅgāni sakalena śāstreṇopadiśyanta ityācāryaḥ pratijānīte| bhaṅgyā vibhavakalpanāyāścāsyāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ| ayaṃ vyākhyāyā vibhavo bhavati| sa tu vinaiva vyākhyāyāḥ paṭhyamāna eveti| saptadaśa tācchilyādīnītyuktam | tadyathā- tācchīlyam avayavaḥ vikāraḥ sāmīpyam bhūyastvam prakāraḥ guṇiguṇavibhavaḥ saṃsaktatā taddharmatā sthānam tādarththyam sāhacaryam karma guṇanimittatā ceṣṭānimittatā mūlasaṃjñā tātsthyam iti| tācchīlyam | avayavaḥ | vikāraḥ| sāmīpyam | bhūyastvam | prakāraḥ | guṇiguṇavibhavaḥ | saṃsaktatā | taddharmatā| sthānam | tādarththyam | sāhacaryam | karma | guṇanimittatā | ceṣṭānimittatā | mūlasaṃjñā | tātsthyam | tatra tācchīlyaṃ nāma - yatkenacideva dharmasādṛśyena yukto bhāvastācchīlyamucyate| yathā-sarvāṅgasaṃśrayastodabhedasphuraṇabhañjanam| stambhanākṣepaṇasvāpasandhyākuñcanakampanam|| kupito'nilaḥ karoti| ityante na cāṅgāni svapanti| kiṃ tarhi devadattaḥ svapiti| taddharmasādṛśyādaṅgāni svāpaśabdenocyante| tadyathā- puruṣaḥ supto na kiñcidvedayate| na cetayate| tathā'ṅgāmapi yatkiñcinna vedayate nakhatodādi| tatsuptamiva suptamityucyate| iti avayavo nāma - yatraikadeśodāharaṇe kriyamāṇe'nukto'nyo'pi tajjātīyako'rtho labhyate| yathā- laṅghanaiḥ kṣapite doṣe dīpte'gnau lāghave sati| svāsthyaṃ kṣuttṛḍruciḥ paktirbalamojaśca jāyate|| ityanenaikadeśodāharaṇena laṅghanena doṣakṣapaṇena lāghave sati svāsthyādayo'nuktā api labhyante| vikāro nāma - viparītakriyā| yathā - vikārasaṃjñayā prakṛtirapi labhyate| prakṛtisaṃjñayā ca vikāraḥ| tatra vikārasaṃjñayā ca prakṛtiryathā -puṣpe patre phale nāle kande ca gurutā kramāt| iti śākamadhikṛtyoktam| atra prakṛtiḥ pāṭhāśūkāṣādīnāṃ patrādīni| tāni hi pākena vikriyamāṇāni cāvasthāntaraṃ pratipadyamānāni śākasaṃjñāṃ labhante| tadayaṃ śāstrakārasteṣāṃ vikārasaṃjñāṃ yavādimaṇḍalādisaṃjñayā yavādikaṃ coktavān| sāmīpyaṃ nāma bhūyastvaṃ nāma- yadekasmin vartamānamadhikyena kvacillabhyate| yathā tantre- amlo bhaktaṃ rocayati ityuktaṃ na ca madhurādirapi rocayatīti| kasyaciccāmlavidveṣiṇo'mlo raso bhaktavidveṣameva kuryāt| tatra bhūyastvamāśrityedamuktam- amlo rocayati| kadācid kasyacidvā nāsau rocayenna tāvatā tanna rocanam| prakāro nāma - yo yasya samānadharmā sa tasya prakāraḥ| yathā- kaṇṭhameraṇḍanālena spṛśan vamet| ityuktam| na ca tatprakārāṇāṃ suvarcalāśatapuṣpādinālānāṃ na grahaṇam| guṇaguṇivibhavo nāma - kvacit guṇīni guṇaśabdenoktāni yasmādāha- pārthivāḥ pārthivāneva iti| na hi pārthivā guṇāḥ santi kecit ye paṭhyeran| guṇaśca guṇivadyathā- meghāsmṛtibalopetā babhūvuramitāyuṣaḥ| iti| atrāyuguṇopetamamitatvāt| nāyuṣaḥ parimāṇaguṇa āyuguṇenaiva śakyaḥ| saṃsaktatā nāma - yadekasya bahubhiḥ sambandhaḥ| yathāvidyamāneṣvapi tatrānyeṣu sambandheṣu tasyaiva vyapadeśaḥ kriyate| yathāvidyamāneṣvapi tatrānyeṣu sambandheṣu tasyaiva vyapadeśaḥ kriyate| yathā - madhuraskandhanirdeśena mākṣikādayo guṇitāḥ kaṣāyādirasopetā api madhuraprāyatvān madhurasaṃsaktatayā| taddharmatā nāma- yena tathābhūtaṃ sattaddharmatāmāsādya darśanāttāmevākhyāṃ labhate| yathā- vivarjayedbhiṣakpāśān pāśān vaivasvatāniva| iti| māraṇadharmo hi vaivasvatapāśena samāno dṛṣṭa ityataste'pi tathaivoktāḥ| sthānaṃ nāma -yatra sthāninā sthānaṃ sthānena vā sthānī vyapadiśyate| tatra sthāninā sthānaṃ yathā- karṇanādaḥ śrotraroga ityuktaḥ| na ca śrotrendriyasyāsti nādaḥ kiṃ tarhi tadadhiṣṭhānasya karṇasya| tasmādayaṃ śrotreṇa sthāninā karṇamadhiṣṭhānamuktavān| sthānena sthānī yathā- jihvā rasaṃ gṛhṇāti| tatra na jihvā rasaṃ gṛhṇāti kiṃ tarhi rasanā| tādarthyaṃ nāma - yatpryojanārthaṃ pravarttate yo bhāvastenaiva vyapadiśyate| yathā- madanamadhukalambā ityādini chardanāni- chardanaprayojanānītyarthaḥ| sāhacaryaṃ nāma- yo yena nityaṃ sambandha upalabhyate sa tasmāt sambandhāttameva sambandhiśabdaṃ labhate| yathā- mathyamānād dhūmaṃ dṛṣṭvājvaladbhāsuraṃ vahnidravyamavaśyamabhyutthito vahnirityeva| karma nāma- yatra karmakarmeti copacaryate| yathocyate- munayaḥ praśamaṃ jagmuḥ| na cāgrāmasthānīyaḥ kaścitpraśamo'sti| kiṃ tarhi indriyāṇāṃ viṣayebhyaḥ kevalaṃ śaktiniyamaḥ praśamaḥ| atha ca gatiḥ- karmaviṣayebhyastvindriyāṇāṃ kriyānivṛttiḥ| tadeva karmetyuktam| guṇanimittaṃ nāma - yatkasya vibhūtiḥ praśaṃsādikā khyāpyate| dharmyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ lokadvayaparāyaṇam anumodāmahe brahmacaryamekāntanirmalam|| iti brahmacaryasya home guṇāḥ nābrahmacaryasyeti| ceṣṭānimittaṃ nāma - yathā pakve jale jīrṇepyāmaṃ na peyamityucyamāne abhojanādityanucyamānasyāpi sāmarthyādāgamanam||13|| nirṇayo nāma uddiṣṭānāmarthānāmanuddiṣṭena nirākāṅkṣatvāpadanaṃ nirṇayaḥ| yathā vartmarogavijñānīyoktānāṃ rogāṇāṃ vartmarogapratiṣedhanirākāṅkṣatvāpādanam||14|| prasaṅgo nāma yadaprākaraṇikasyāpi vastunaḥ kiñcit sambandhena yat kīrtanaṃ sa hi prasaṅgaḥ| yathā vamanaprastāve dhūmāntaiḥ prāyaḥ sarvairityāderaprakāraṇikasya kīrttanam||15|| ekānto nāma yat pakṣāntaravyāvarttakaṃ tadekāntaḥ| yathā doṣahetujatvokternijatvaṃ na kadācidapi bāhyahetujaṃ tadekāntaḥ| yathā doṣahetujatvokternijatvaṃ na kadācidapi bāhyahetujaṃ vyāpnoti||16|| naikānto nāma yaducyamānamapyavaśyambhāvitvenaniyataṃ sa naikāntaḥ| yathā jvarastu jātaḥ ṣaḍrātrādaśivanīṣu nivartata ityetaduktamapyavaśyambhāvitvenāniyatam||17|| apavargo nāma sāmānyoktyanupraviṣṭasya viśeṣeṇākarṣaṇaṃ sopavargaḥ| yathā madhuraṃ śleṣmalamityuktāvanupraviṣṭeṣu jīrṇaśālyādiṣu śabdenākarṣaṇam||18|| viparyayo nāma uktasyānyathābhāvo viparyayaḥ| yathā nidānoktānāmanupaśayo bhavati tadviparītānāṃ copaśayaḥ||19|| pūrvapakṣo nāma parapatijñātānupapattipradarśanaparo vākyasamudāyaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ yathā ṣaḍrasavādinaṃ pratyanekarasapratipādakāni vākyāni||20|| vidhānaṃ nāma tantrasya kartā viśiṣṭā yā padādiracanā kṛtā tadvidhānam| yathā sarvavirodhaparijñānadvyavahārocchittirmābhūdityabhiprāyeṇoktaṃ na ca tadvijñānamekāntabhadrakamiti|| 21|| anumataṃ nāma parapakṣasya bhinnasyāpyāṅgīkaraṇamanumatam| yathā vastividhāne kalpanāyā mateṣu doṣauṣadhādibalataḥ sarvametat pramāṇayedityaṅgīkaraṇam||22|| vyākhyānaṃ nāma saṅkṣepeṇoktasyārthasya vistāreṇākhyānaṃ vyākhyānam| athavā sphuṭaiḥ śabdairanabhihitaṃ guruparamparyakramāgatam||23|| saṃśayo nāma viruddhānāṃ pakṣāṇāmaniścayaḥ saṃśayaḥ| yathā viṣavegasaṃbhavapakṣeṣu||24|| atītāpekṣā nāma yatrātītaṃ padamāpekṣya sambandhārthatā bhavati sātitāpekṣā| yathā ca svedyādayaḥ snehyāḥ ityukte natvatimandāgnirityādeḥ snehyāḥ ityapekṣate| yathā ca jvare laṅghanaṃ kurvīteti sūtroktaṃ laṅghanamapekṣate||25|| anāgatāpekṣā nāma yatrātītaṃ padamapekṣya sambandhārthatā bhavati sānāgatāpekṣā| yathā tato nāvanagaṇḍūṣetyādinā dinacaryāyāṃ nasyādividhayo'pekṣyante||26|| svasaṃjñā nāma svatantre evamanyasmiñchāstre na śrūyate sā svasaṃjñā| yathā āpānojentāka ityevamādi||27|| ūhyaṃ nāma yat bhiṣrijā svaprajñayā śabdenānuktamapi vyavasthāpyate tadūhyam| yathā dravyaṃ jahyādayaugikamiti yanna yaugikaṃ tacchabdena noktamapi prajñayā vyapasthāpyate||28|| samuccayo nāma ekasmin vihite tadavirodhena tatraiva dvitīyasya vidhānaṃ samuccayaḥ| yathā vātasyopakramaḥ snehaḥ svedaḥ ityādi||29|| nidarśanaṃ nāma sādhyaikadeśo dṛṣṭānto nidarśanam| yathā āmadoṣeṣu trividheṣu laṅghanapācanaśodhanāni dṛṣṭāntaḥ| evamanyānapi vyādhīn svanidānaviparyayāt cikitsedityādeḥ||30|| nirvacanaṃ nāma saṃjñayoktasya tadarthena yojanaṃ nirvacanaṃ| yathā sūcībhiriva gātrāṇi bhidyatīti viṣūcikā||31|| niyogo nāma kriyāṇāṃ vyāpārāṇāṃ niyogaḥ| yathā bhavatā svedamūrcchāparītenāpi naiṣā piṇḍikā vimoktavyeti||32|| viklpo nāma krameṇa yaugapadyena vā sambhavināṃ pakṣāṇāṃ kīrttanam| yathā kurvīta laṅghanaṃ pragrūpeṣu jvarādau vā||33|| pratyutsāro nāma yatropapattiṃ darśayantaḥ parasparamatāni nivārayanti| yathā garbhiṇī aṣṭame māsi kṣīrayavāgū sarpiṣmatīṃ pibet neti khaṇḍakāpyaḥ garbhasya paiṅgalyā bādhabhayāt| astu paiṅglayā bādhāstathāpyevaṃ kurvatī nirujaṃ balavarṇādyupetamapatyaṃ janayatīti bhagavānatreyaḥ||34|| uddhāro nāma yacchāstre codyasya samādhānam| yathā citrakarmaguṇakṛt guruṇokto vastirityādi yāvat sarvataḥ kathamapohati doṣāniti codyasya stimitamārutavaśyametadityādi samādhānam||35|| sambhavo nāma kimapyanyatrādarśanādyena niyamena sthāpyate sa sambhavaḥ| yathā sarvarogeṣu hetuliṅgauṣadhādīnāṃ sāmānyoktau vātādiviśeṣaṇāsthāpanaṃ sambhavaprasādāllabhyam||36|| evaṃ tantrayuktayaḥ|| yadyapi bhaṭṭārakaprasthānena ca paripraśnavyākaraṇavyutkrāntābhidhānahetvākhyāścatasrovaśiṣyante tathāpi ācāryeṇa tantreṇānibaddhā ityatra nocyante| athavā tantrayuktitvameva tāsāṃ nāṅgīkriyate| tatra cāgnyatiyogoktau vātādiviśeṣeṇāvasthāpanaṃ sambhavaprasādāllabhyamevādyuktam|| sarasaḥ suptapadmasya ravidīdhitayo yathā| yathā gṛhasya dīpābhāstathā tantrasyayuktayaḥ|| adhīyānopi tantrāṇi tantrayuktyavicakṣaṇaḥ| nādhigacchati tantrārthamarthaṃ bhāgyakṣaye yathā|| sarasa ityādi subodham| tantrayuktyavicakṣaṇaḥ etāsu ṣaṭtriṃśattantrayuktiṣvasamarthastantrārthaṃ nādhigacchati na prāpnoti yathā bhāgyakṣaye dhanam|| vākyārthayojanādetā yuktayastviṣṭasiddhidāḥ| asadvādiprayuktānāṃ vākyānāṃ pratiṣedhakāḥ|| līnavyatyāsaleśoktigaditānāṃ prakāśakāḥ| vākyanyāyodadheḥ sāraṃ gṛhītvaivaṃ vyavasthitāḥ|| etā yuktayo vākyārthasya yojanāddhetoḥ sveṣṭasiddhiṃ dadati| yāni cāsadvādināmarthasambandhapradarśanaparaṇi vākyāni teṣāṃ pratiṣedhakāḥ| līnagaditānāṃ vyatyāsagaditānāṃ ca prakāśakāḥ| līnaṃ tadyat sphuṭaṃ vaktuṃ na pāryate| vyatyāsaḥ parasparavivartanam| leśoṃśena noktāḥ| yukti śabdaḥ khalūpāyavācī| nahyetā yuktīḥ pratyākhyāya śakyate tantraṃ praṇetum| tatra kāścid yuktayaḥ vākyaprayojanā uddeśanirdeśādayaḥ| kāścidarthaprayojanā adhikaraṇapadārthādayaḥ|
